name: Kling AI Official MCP
description: Official hosted Kling AI MCP for image and video creation through compatible agents. Global users connect via OAuth; generation consumes paid personal workspace credits. China uses https://klingai.com/mcp/plugin with separate accounts, credits and tasks. The public Claude plugin is client configuration, not the hosted backend source. Full plugin package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klingai/plugin-global
